sections.content: You know these tools from this unit and from earlier ones: *creo que* (B1 Unit 7), *sin embargo* (B1 Unit 1), *por eso* (A2 Unit 5) and *es necesario que* (A2 Unit 27). A public discussion combines description, opinion, evaluation, agreement, disagreement and recommendations. Organise a contribution by stating the issue, explaining your position, acknowledging another view and proposing a practical action.

items.spanish: El problema afecta a muchos ciudadanos.
Creo que la propuesta puede funcionar.
items.english: I think the proposal can work.

items.spanish: Sin embargo, debemos considerar su coste.
items.english: However, we must consider its cost.

items.spanish: Por eso, es necesario que estudiemos otras opciones.
items.english: Therefore, it is necessary that we study other options.

sections.content: Build a discussion contribution from issue to position, qualification and proposal.
